rows.title_full: AN ACT PRESCRIBING THE PHILIPPINE ROAD TRAFFIC CODE
rows.abstract: "Philippine Road Traffic Code" Intends to: (1) provide motorists with a revised, comprehensive and unfirom set of raod traffic regulations for easy referecne and understanding; (2) institutionaliz e and popularize traffic control devices; and (3) prescribe new regulations for bus and PUJ lanes, pedestrian crossing and regulatory signs.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on TRANSPORTATION AND COMMUNICATIONS since 1995-08-28

rows.author: A089
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR COMPREHENSIVE CONSERVATION, PROTECTION, UTILIZATION, DEVELOPMENT AND MANAGEMENT OF THE PHILIPPINE EXCLUSIVE ECONOMIC ZONE (EEZ)
rows.abstract: "The Philippine Exclusive Economic Zone Act of 1995" Provides that the exclusive economic zone shall extend to a distance of two hundred (200) nautical miles from the baselines from which the breadth of the territorial sea is measured. Reserves theexclusive use and enjoyment of the marine resources therein to the Filipinos. Institutionaliz es plans and programs for conservation and management of resources of the patrimonial sea.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on NATURAL RESOURCES since 1995-08-28

rows.author: A089
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO REQUIRE INDUSTRIES, FACTORIES, COMPANIES, OR ANY INSTITUTION, FIRM OR ESTABLISHMENT USING CHEMICALS AND THEIR BY-PRODUCTS FOR PRODUCTION TO DEVELOP AND PROMOTE A COMMUNITY ENVIRONMENT INFORMATION PROGRAM
rows.abstract: "Community Environmental Information Program of 1995" Covers all industries, corporations, business firms and establishments that derive raw materials from the communities, or produce and discard their by-products in the community. Intends to require all corporations to: (1) ensure that all its operations for production do not cause pollution and do not endanger the ecological the ecological balance of community ecosystems; and (2) orient, educate and inform the community residents of the possible risks and safety measures in the use of chemicals and their by-products.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on ECOLOGY since 1995-08-28

rows.author: A089
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE INSTALLATION OF ANTI-POLLUTION DEVICES AS PREREQUISITE TO THE REGISTRATION AND ISSUANCE OF LICENSES AND LICENSE PLATE NUMBERS TO VEHICLES NEWLY REGISTERED, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Is based on the observation that the major sources of air pollution are the hundred of thousand of vehicles traversing roads and streets everyday. Mandates, therefore, the installation of anti-pollution devises as a requirement for vehicle registration which aims to lessen air pollution.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on TRANSPORTATION AND COMMUNICATIONS since 1995-08-28

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE REGULATION AND DISPOSAL OF MEDICAL WASTES, DECLARING CERTAIN ACTS UNLAWFUL, PRESCRIBING PENALTIES THERETO, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: "Medical Waste Control Act of 1995"  Defines the meaning of the term "medical wastes"; empowers the Secretary of Health to establish acceptable standards for its regulation, management and disposal. States that all local government units shall havea complementary role in the enforcement of the provisions of this Act.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HEALTH since 1995-08-28

rows.abstract: "Prosecution Service Academy Act of the Philippines" Lays down, directs and implements a uniform system for the admission, training and preparation of qualified lawyers into the prosecution service in order to professionalize and improve the qualityand delivery of its work. Establishes the Career Prosecution Service Development Program.
rows.status: Substituted by HB07109

rows.title_full: AN ACT REQUIRING ALL FOREIGNERS TO PRESENT PROOFS OR CERTIFICATES THAT THEY ARE HIV/AIDS NEGATIVE UPON ENTRY TO THE COUNTRY OR IN THE ABSENCE THEREOF TO SUBMIT THEMSELVES TO HIV/AIDS-TESTIN G SO AS TO CONTROL THE SPREAD OF THE AIDS EPIDEMIC IN THE COUNTRY
rows.abstract: Applies to any foreigner, whether holding a tourist, immigrant or other visa, whether male or female, child or adult, and whether he intends to stay in the country on a temporary or permanent basis; DOES NOT APPLY, however to members of athe diplomatic corps, international organizations and such other foreigners who may be given special privilege by the Department of Foreign Affairs.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HEALTH since 1995-08-28

rows.author: A022
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE INCREASE OF THE AUTHORIZED CAPITAL STOCK OF THE NATIONAL ELECTRIFICATION ADMINISTRATION AND ORDAINING THE ENERGIZATION OF ALL BARANGAYS, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE PRESIDENTIAL DECREE NUMBERED TWO HUNDRED AND SIXTY-NINE, AS AMENDED, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE 'NATIONAL ELECTRIFICATION ADMINISTRATION DECREE'
rows.abstract: Increases the capitalization of the National Electrification Administration (NEA) from [five (5) Billion] to TWENTY-FIVE BILLION PESOS (P25 BILLION). Aims to energize all barangays within the next 15 years by further extending financial assistance to the rural electric cooperatives. Allows the conversion into equity of all advances by the National Treasury for NEA's foreign loans and for its outstanding liabilities for rural electrification projects.
rows.status: Substituted by HB02356

rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING CERTAIN PROVISION OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7881, AMENDING REPUBLIC ACT NO. 6657 OR THE 'COMPREHENSIVE AGRARIAN REFORM LAW OF 1988' ON EXEMPTION TO THE AGRARIAN REFORM PROGRAM'
rows.abstract: "Fruit Farm/Orchard/Tr ee Farm and 18% Slopes Exemption from the Agrarian Reform Act" Proposes to EXEMPT fruit farms and all 18% sloping terrain, from the coverage of the Agrarian REform Act in order to develop a renewed interest in fruit farming, orhard and tree farming activity throughout the country, thereby devleoping upland areas and reforestation of denuded hills.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on AGRARIAN REFORM since 1995-08-28

rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING PRESIDENTIAL DECREE NO. 717, ENTITLED 'PROVIDING AN AGRARIAN REFORM CREDIT AND FINANCING SYSTEM FOR AGRARIAN REFORM BENEFICIARIES THROUGH BANKING INSTITUTIONS
rows.abstract: Allows banking institutions to invest or deposit its loanable funds for agrarian reform  credit with the Land Bank of the Philippine for relending such "funds" to farmers and agrarian reform beneficiaries.

rows.title_full: AN ACT MAKING THE ABOT-KAYA PABAHAY FUND A REGULAR AND CONTINUING COMPONENT OF THE NATIONAL SHELTER PROGRAM AND EXPANDING ITS SCOPE OF OPERATIONS, THEREBY AMENDING REPUBLIC ACT NUMBERED 6846, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE 'SOCIAL HOUSING SUPPORT FUND ACT,'APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: "Abot-Kaya Pabahay Fund Amendment Act of 1995" Assresses the problem of the lack of enough funding support for the housing industry, thereby expanding the level of the Abot-Kaya Pabahay Fund's amortization support, scope of developmental financing and cashflow guarantees. Introduces a liquidity support and interest shortfall subsidy system to strengthen the secondary mortgage market and other lending operations of the government.

rows.title_full: AN ACT STRENGTHENING THE PHILIPPINE NATIONAL POLICE ACADEMY, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Declares that the "Academy" shall be the primary and exclusive training, education and development facility in the country for PNP members and officers. Provides for these concerns: (1) branches of the Academy; (2) academic programs; (3) candidatesfor admission; and (4) full professionaliza tion.  Adopts a parallel professionaliza tion program for SECURITY GUARDS in the country.
rows.status: Substituted by HB10089

rows.author: A091
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO PROVIDE A UNIFORM MANDATORY PERIOD FOR PRELIMINARY INVESTIGATION
rows.abstract: States that preliminary investigation shall be conducted and termianted within a period of FIFTEEN (15) DAYS upon receipt by the investigating prosecutor of the affidavits of the complaint and his witnesses. States that failure to observe the mandatory periods which are NON-EXTENDIBLE shall constitute a ground for suspension or removal.

rows.abstract: Is in keeping with the cosntitutional precept that the accused is presumed innocent until proven otherwise. Intends to benefit more the poor litigants who might be extremely prejudiced by the requirement of the bail. rows.abstract: "The Anti-Political Dynasty Act of 1995" States the cases when political dynasty exists.  Is proposed to guarantee equal access to public service, thereby laying down the basis of greater enpowerment for the greater number of Filipinos and providingfor the diffusion of economic and political influence among the citizenry.
